parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplicate 'MetricRow.body' computed property in that file is a local debug convenience for the Wallpaper sample app, not a production artefact. Merging or extracting it alongside the production 'DebugPanel' copy at 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' would couple the production DebugPanel package to sample-app semantics. The correct disposition is to leave both in place.
